specs.title: 3. Complete Phone Verification (if required)

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies
Token Delivery: cookies | Verification: email | MFA: ADAPTIVE (grace: 0d)
Get SMS code from /test/sms/latest → POST /auth/verify-phone/verify → POST /auth/challenges/complete. May trigger MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED if MFA required with no grace period.
Skipped if phone verification not required

specs.title: 3b. Complete MFA Setup (if required)

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies
Token Delivery: cookies | MFA: ADAPTIVE (grace: 0d)
Get SMS code from /test/sms/latest → POST /auth/mfa/sms/verify-setup-challenge → POST /auth/challenges/complete. Only runs if MFA required with no grace period.
Skipped if MFA not required or grace period > 0

specs.title: 4. Login

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies
Token Delivery: cookies | User should be verified from previous steps
POST /auth/login (or /mobile) with email and password. Expect tokens in response (cookies or JSON body).

specs.title: 5. Refresh Token

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies
Token Delivery: cookies | Uses refresh token from previous login
POST /auth/refresh (or /mobile) with refresh token. Expect new access token in response.

specs.title: 6. Change IP and Login Again (for adaptive MFA testing)

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies
Token Delivery: cookies | MFA: ADAPTIVE | Simulates location change
Set IP to 203.0.113.1 → POST /auth/login. With adaptive MFA, may trigger challenge if risk detected.
Skipped if adaptive MFA not enabled

specs.title: 7. Logout

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies
Token Delivery: cookies | Validates token/cookie invalidation
GET /auth/logout with access token. Expect tokens/cookies cleared (expired or maxAge=0).

suites.title: Deferred Verification - Email Only: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies | @email @mfa-adaptive
Skip Email Verification at Signup, Verify at Login

specs.title: 1. Signup (skip email verification)

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies - Deferred Email Verification
Token Delivery: cookies | Verification: email
POST /auth/signup (or /mobile) with email. Receive VERIFY_EMAIL challenge but do NOT complete it. User remains unverified.
User skips email verification at signup, will be challenged on login
Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies - Deferred Email Verification
Token Delivery: cookies | Verification: email
POST /auth/signup (or /mobile) with email. Receive VERIFY_EMAIL challenge but do NOT complete it. User remains unverified.
User skips email verification at signup, will be challenged on login

specs.title: 2. Login (triggers email verification challenge)

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies - Deferred Email Verification
Token Delivery: cookies | User is unverified from previous step
POST /auth/login (or /mobile) with email and password. Should return VERIFY_EMAIL challenge since email is not verified.
Login enforces verification that was skipped at signup
Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies - Deferred Email Verification
Token Delivery: cookies | User is unverified from previous step
POST /auth/login (or /mobile) with email and password. Should return VERIFY_EMAIL challenge since email is not verified.
Login enforces verification that was skipped at signup

specs.title: 3. Complete Email Verification (from login challenge)

annotations.description: Config: email-verify-mfa-adaptive-cookies - Deferred Email Verification
Token Delivery: cookies | Completing verification from login challenge
Get email code from /test/email/latest → POST /auth/verify-email/verify → POST /auth/challenges/complete. Should receive tokens after verification.
